description: This file defines a static class ApplicationPartAttributeGenerator with a method GenerateSyntax that creates C# syntax for assembly attributes referencing application parts in the Orleans code generation framework.

classes.name: ApplicationPartAttributeGenerator
classes.description: A static utility class for generating syntax for application part attributes in Orleans code generation.

methods.name: GenerateSyntax
methods.description: Generates a list of C# SyntaxNode representations of assembly-level ApplicationPart attributes based on provided application parts.
